Every release gets an inclusion review (see `docs/EQUALITY-AND-DATA-PROTECTION-SCREENING.md`). Tick each item when checked, and open an issue for anything that fails.

- [ ] New or changed pages work with a screen reader, keyboard only and at 400% zoom
- [ ] Each changed page's "In short" summary still matches the page
- [ ] Checks, examples and guidance work for all four UK nations, and for Crown Dependencies and Overseas Territories where relevant
- [ ] Inclusion checks (unknown or defaulted characteristics, gaps between groups) are still offered wherever people's data is involved
- [ ] Nothing new needs an account or licence beyond a free GitHub account, and there is another route (a colleague can submit)
- [ ] Nothing in the release asks for or shows personal data, and no email address appears anywhere
